source.product: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Reflectance, 30 m

references.product: Public Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 STAC archive used for cloud-optimized raster access

scaleNote: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 surface-reflectance pixels at 30 m are classified with MNDWI (green minus SWIR1 divided by green plus SWIR1; water threshold > 0) inside the current OpenStreetMap reservoir outline, relation 2970167. Pixels flagged as fill, dilated cloud, cirrus, cloud, cloud shadow, snow, or saturation are excluded; only scenes with at least 80% valid reservoir pixels are retained. The value is mapped surface area, not dam elevation, stored volume, or water supply. A current shoreline polygon is applied retrospectively, and the spectral threshold is an estimate rather than a gauge observation.

sampling.method: For each complete calendar month, Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 scenes intersecting the Angat Dam Reservoir boundary are ranked by distance from the 15th, with scene-wide cloud cover as a tie-breaker. Each candidate is masked using its QA_PIXEL layer and classified with MNDWI > 0; the nearest scene with at least 80% valid reservoir-pixel coverage is retained. Each water pixel contributes 900 m2. Missing months remain gaps.
sampling.index: MNDWI = (green surface reflectance - SWIR1 surface reflectance) / (green + SWIR1); water threshold > 0
sampling.qualityMask: QA_PIXEL fill, dilated cloud, cirrus, cloud, cloud shadow, snow bits, and any QA_RADSAT flag are excluded.
